description.value: Sansho is a Japanese sushi and dining restaurant anchored by chef Hideki Yamamoto, who spent twenty years running Dharma Sushi in Halifax before bringing his thirty years of sushi expertise to North Vancouver. The restaurant sits in Queensbury Market at the foot of Grand Boulevard, offering a broad menu spanning izakaya starters, sashimi, specialty rolls, noodles, and teriyaki dinners. A dedicated gluten-free menu and online ordering make it a practical meal stop for cyclists with dietary needs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (707 Queensbury Ave, North Vancouver, BC) and phone (778-340-1189), and the takeaway=yes OSM tag is corroborated by the site's 'Available ONLINE orders' notice. The website lists an explicit GLUTEN-FREE menu section, supporting a GF amenity claim. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, or washroom availability, so those remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: Website copyright still reads 2014, suggesting the site has not been updated in over a decade; business appears open but information currency cannot be fully verified.
Contact page advises 'We may not check emails on a regular basis' — phone is the preferred contact method for reservations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Sansho is a clearly operating, cyclist-accessible restaurant with takeout and gluten-free options, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence. A brief on-site or direct-contact verification would resolve the listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Located in Queensbury Market with a bus stop directly in front (#228 from Lonsdale) and street parking nearby; no cyclist-specific amenity information available from current sources.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists a dedicated 'GLUTEN-FREE' special menu section and 'GLUTEN FREE OPTIONS' within the main menu
